title: a tester run casts reds only into its own checkout's commons
intention: A tester run casts a red ticket only into the commons that belongs to its own checkout. When <repo>.parent/CairnCommons resolves into another checkout (a symlink), it casts nothing there, raises StoreUnreachable naming the symlink and its target, and the red stays in the run's own record.
why: Measured 2026-11-19: a tester --reseal run in worktree wt-93fa, whose CairnCommons was a symlink to the house commons, cast red ticket 1d547c70f1c3 and its sorted berth into the house commons, staged and uncommitted. The red named a proof that exists only on branch cc0/93fa-move. It blocked the PROVED closes of 266d39d56d06, 17d5, 1e99 and a4892 on working_tree_clean until it was withdrawn (CairnCommons 271e3e32).
traces_to: Law 6: everything has exactly one owner, and the owner alone gates writes to it. The house commons is not a worktree run's to write.
how: In cairn/devices/tester/red_tickets.py, _commons_top (line 269; its only caller is ticket_what_is_new, line 412) resolves the store path. If the store's realpath is not under the unresolved <repo>.parent/CairnCommons, where repo is _repo(), it raises StoreUnreachable('*', 'commit', [...]), naming the symlink and its target. cairn/devices/tester/device.py:949 already catches StoreUnreachable, so the run goes on. The red-first proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_red_casts_only_into_its_own_commons.py builds two scratch git repos under tmp_path, marked testing.

clauses.claim: in a scratch checkout whose CairnCommons is a symlink to a second scratch commons, ticket_what_is_new over a red raises StoreUnreachable naming the symlink and its target, and the second commons gains no file
in the same symlinked setup, cast_ticket through the symlinked store lands, so only red casting is guarded and the deliberate symlink setups of the chart doors and hollow runs keep working

falsifier.wrong_intent: a worktree's own reds are meant to land in the house commons

decisions.text: D1: _commons_top refuses a store whose realpath leaves <repo>.parent/CairnCommons, raising StoreUnreachable with the symlink and its target in its lacks (clause 1).
D2: the proof's second tooth casts a ticket through cast_ticket into the same symlinked store and finds it landed, so the guard is scoped to red casting (clause 2).

out: the chart doors and hollow runs, which keep using a symlinked commons
every other caller of the ticket store
